summary: The endpoint aggregates are convex combinations in the canonical half-metronoids, midpoint stability gives the stated target metronoid membership and depth, and the quarter-capacity bounds give both the edgewise depth scale and loop-mass comparison. The ambient-halfspace orientation argument charges each selected labelled edge to a distinct source fiber because the matching is endpoint-disjoint, so it remains valid under all target-atom collisions. All constants, strict inequalities, integrality conditions, and nonterminal qualifications match the accepted predecessor facts.
